title: 30 MINUTES MOST POWERFUL PSALM 91 MORNING PRAYER TO START YOUR DAY
text: Before we begin, hear me in the spirit. This is not just another prayer you scroll past. Someone you are connected to by blood, by marriage, by destiny is standing at the edge of a decision that will determine the next 10 years of your life. The enemy knows that if this word reaches them, everything changes. I am under strict instruction from the Holy Spirit to tell you, share this message. Send it now. Post it where they can see it. God is orchestrating last-minute interventions, divine surprises, midnight deliverances. What looked impossible yesterday is about to bow before the decree of the Almighty. Do not keep this to yourself. Heaven is about to shock the mockers. Now, lift up your voice wherever you are and say, "Father, I thank you that I have not stumbled on this word by accident. I receive grace to pray through. I receive grace to decree with accuracy. I receive grace to believe again in the mighty name of Jesus." Let me establish something in the spirit this morning before we go into warfare. When God inspired the psalmist to pen Psalm 91, he was not giving us poetry. He was releasing a covenant document. He was encoding into scripture a legal framework by which the children of light can enforce divine protection in a fallen world. You must understand that every word of God carries legal authority in the realm of the spirit. The Bible says in John chapter 6 verse 63, "It is the spirit that quickeneth. The flesh PROFITETH NOTHING. THE WORDS THAT I speak unto you, they are spirit and they are life." When you decree the word of God, you are not hoping, you are enforcing. You are not begging, you are legislating. Psalm 91 begins with a condition. "He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most high shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty." Dwelling is not visiting. Dwelling is residency. It is habitation. It is covenant positioning. There are believers who visit God in prayer and there are believers who dwell with God in intimacy. The shadow of the Almighty is not available to spiritual tourist. It is the inheritance of those who have made God their habitation. And I want you to Look at verse two. "I will say of the Lord, he is my refuge and my fortress. My God, in him will I trust." Notice the psalmist moved from third person to first person. From observation to declaration. From theology to testimony. It is not enough to know that God is a refuge. You must personally declare it. You must say it with your mouth. You must decree it into your atmosphere. Death and life are in the power of the tongue. The enemy does not respond to what you know. He responds to what you decree. Your mouth is a weapon. Your tongue is a legislative instrument. And this morning we are going to open our mouths and change the narrative. Let me go further. Verse three says, "Surely, he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler and from the noisome pestilence." The fowler is the professional trapper. He is the one who sets snares for birds. He is calculating. He is patient. He is hidden. That is the nature of demonic ambush. The enemy does not always attack you openly. Sometimes he sets traps. He waits for you to walk into agreements, into covenants, into atmospheres that give him legal access. But the promise is sure. He shall deliver you. Not maybe. Not if you are lucky. Surely, it is guaranteed. It is covenant. It is settled. And then the pestilence. We just came out of a season where the whole world saw what pestilence can do. We saw nations shut down. We saw economies collapse. We saw fear grip the hearts of men. But in the midst of it all, there was a people who stood on Psalm 91 and they were kept. They were shielded. They were preserved. Because this is not just a nice scripture to read. It is a covenant of protection for those who dwell in the secret place. Now, I want you to lift up your voice and begin to pray with me. Do not be passive. Do not be religious. Let the fire of the Holy Ghost baptize your tongue. Open your mouth and decree. "Father, I thank you for the blood of Jesus that speaks better things than the blood of Abel. I cover myself, my family, my children, my finances, my health, my destiny with the blood of the lamb. Every arrow Let me tell you something. There is a dimension of prayer where you are not asking God to do something. You are enforcing what he has already done. You are taking the finished work of Calvary and applying it to your present situation. Jesus did not die so you can beg. He died so you can decree. He did not shed his blood so you can be afraid. He shed his blood so you can be bold. The Bible says in Hebrews 4:16, "Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace that we may obtain mercy and find grace to help in time of need." Boldly. Not timidly. Not apologetically. Boldly. Verse four says, "He shall cover thee with his feathers and under his wings shall thou trust. His truth shall be thy shield and buckler." This is covenant language. This is the language of intimacy. Have you ever watched a hen gather her chicks under her wings when danger is near? The chicks do not strategize. They do not panic. They simply run to the covering. And once they are under the wings, the mother hen will fight to the death to protect them. That is the picture God is painting. He is not a distant deity. He is a covenant-keeping father who covers his children with his presence. And then he says, "His truth shall be your shield and buckler." Shield is for frontal attacks. Buckler is for attacks from behind. God is saying, "I have got you covered on every side. The enemy cannot ambush you. He cannot outmaneuver you because divine intelligence is working on your behalf." The Bible says in Isaiah 54:17, "No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper. And every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment, thou shalt condemn." This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord and their righteousness is of me, saith the Lord. This is your heritage. Not your hope. Your heritage. Now, let me prophesy to someone. Thus saith the spirit of the Lord, "The snare that was set for you in the place of your expectation, I am destroying it now. The enemy thought he would catch you at the door of your breakthrough, but I am sending angelic intervention to dismantle every trap." Shout a prophetic amen wherever you are. for the terror by night, nor for the arrow that flieth by day, nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness, nor for the destruction that wasted at noonday." Four dimensions of attack. Terror by night. That is fear, nightmares, anxiety, demonic oppression that comes when the sun goes down. Arrow that flies by day. That is open confrontation, visible enemies, public attacks. Pestilence in darkness. That is hidden sickness, silent killers, diseases that creep in unnoticed. Destruction at noonday. That is sudden calamity, unexpected tragedy, things that happen when you are at the peak of your day. God is saying, "None of these shall touch you. You will not be afraid. Not because there is no danger, but because you are covered. You are hidden. You are shielded." Fear is not your portion. Anxiety is not your language. Terror is not your inheritance. The Bible says in 2 Timothy 1:7, "For God has not given us the spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind." If God did not give you fear, then where did it come from? It came from the enemy. And what came from the enemy has no legal right to stay in your life. I want you to open your mouth and begin to cast out every spirit of fear. Call it by name. Fear of failure. Fear of death. Fear of rejection. Fear of the future. Fear of poverty. Command it to leave now in the name of Jesus. SPIRIT OF FEAR, I BIND YOU NOW in the name of Jesus. You have no authority over my life. You have no place in my mind. YOU HAVE NO CLAIM ON MY DESTINY. I am a child of the living God. I am seated with Christ in heavenly places. I am more than a conqueror through him that love me. Therefore, I DECREE THAT EVERY TERROR BY NIGHT, I silence you by the blood of Jesus. Every arrow that flies by day, I command you to fall to the ground now. Every pestilence that walks in darkness, I EXPOSE YOU BY THE light of the glory of God, AND I COMMAND YOU TO DIE. EVERY destruction that wastes at noonday, now listen to the amplification of the promise in verse seven. A thousand shall fall at thy side, and 10,000 at thy right hand, but it shall not come nigh thee. This is not just protection, this is insulation. This is separation. This is distinction. The Bible is telling you that in the season of mass casualties, you will be exempted. In the day of widespread disaster, you will be preserved. Others may fall, but you will stand. Not because you are better than them, but because you are covered by covenant. And I need to say this carefully because some people misinterpret this verse. God is not saying that he loves you more than the others. He is saying that covenant has privileges. Positioning has benefits. Those who dwell in the secret place, walk in a dimension of protection that is not available to those who live carelessly. This is not elitism. This is covenant reality. [Music] The Bible says in Amos 3:3, "Can two walk together except they be agreed?" If you want to walk in covenant protection, you must walk in covenant alignment. Verse eight says, "Only with thine eyes shall thou behold and see the reward of the wicked." You will be a spectator of judgment, not a victim of it. You will watch the enemy's plans fail. You will see the traps meant for you catch those who set them. You will witness the fall of those who rose against you. And it will be evidence to you that God is real, that he is faithful, that he keeps his word. I prophesy to someone under the sound of my voice. You have watched the wicked prosper while you struggled. You have seen the unrighteous advance while you were delayed. You have witnessed the enemy celebrate while you mourned, but I hear the spirit of God saying, "The table is turning. The script is changing. The season is shifting. What you are about to see with your eyes will erase every doubt. What you are about to witness will SILENCE EVERY QUESTION. THE REWARD OF THE WICKED IS COMING, and you will watch it happen. Not as a victim, but as a witness. Not as prey, but as a spectator. Get ready for vindication. Get ready for reversal. Get ready for the testimony that will make mockers become believers." Verse nine and 10, "Because thou hast made the Lord, which is my refuge, even the most high, thy habitation, there shall no evil befall thee. Neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling." Again, the condition, because you have made the Lord your habitation. Because you have chosen to dwell with him. Because you have positioned yourself in the secret place, therefore, no evil shall befall you. Not some evil. Not little evil. No evil. And not just you personally, but your dwelling, your house, your family, your children, your business, your territory. This is comprehensive coverage. This is total protection. This is divine insurance that never expires, and the premium has already been paid by the blood of Jesus. You do not have to earn it. You do not have to qualify for it. You simply have to access it by faith. You have to decree it. You have to enforce it. You have to walk in it. Lift up your voice and begin to decree over your dwelling place. I decree that my house is the house of the Lord. My home is a habitation of the most high. Therefore, no evil shall befall my household. No plague shall come near my dwelling. Every demonic agent assigned to infiltrate my home, I command you to be exposed and expelled now in the name of Jesus. Every spirit of infirmity trying to attack my family, I bind you now by the authority of the word of God. Every spirit of confusion, strife, divorce, rebellion, backsliding, I command you to LEAVE MY HOME NOW. I sanctify my dwelling place with the blood of Jesus. I set the borders of my property as holy ground. I decree that angels are stationed at every entry point. I decree that the glory of God fills every room. I decree that my home is a place of peace, a place of joy, a place of divine presence, a place of supernatural provision. As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord. Now, watch what happens in verse 11 and 12. "For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways. They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone." Angelic assignment. The Bible says in Hebrews 1:14, "Are they not all ministering spirits sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?" Notice he says for them, not to them. Angels do not minister to you directly. They minister for you. They fight battles on your behalf. They intervene in circumstances you know nothing about. They frustrate the plans of the enemy before those plans even reach you. They create divine diversions that redirect you from danger. They orchestrate divine appointments that connect you to your helpers. And he says they are given charge over you to keep you in all your ways. Not some of your ways. All your ways. When you go out and when you come in. When you sleep and when you wake. When you walk and when you rest. When you travel and when you stay home. In all your ways, angels are watching. In all your ways, angels are guarding. In all your ways, angels are intervening. I want you to activate angelic assistance right now by decree. Father, I thank you for the ministry of angels. I thank you that you have given your angels charge over me. I decree that angelic hosts are released on my behalf now. Let the angel of the Lord encamp around me. Let the chariots of fire surround me. Let the warriors of heaven enforce my victory. I decree that every satanic angel assigned against me, you are arrested now by the angels of the living God. Every monitoring spirit sent to track my movement, you are bound now. EVERY MESSENGER OF DARKNESS SENT to deliver evil assignments into my life, you are returned to sender with divine judgment. I decree safe travel. I decree divine protection. I decree angelic intervention in every situation I face. I shall not dash my foot against a stone. I shall not stumble into error. I shall not fall into traps. For the angels of God bear me up in their hands. [Music] Verse 13 is one of the most powerful declarations in this entire psalm. "Thou shall tread upon the lion and adder. The young lion and the dragon shall thou trample under feet." This is dominion language. This is authority language. This is victory language. You are not running from the lion, you are treading. The lion represents open aggression. The adder represents hidden danger. The young lion represents rising threats. The dragon represents ancient powers. And God is saying you will tread on all of them. You will trample all of them. You will have victory over all of them because greater is he that is in you than he that is in the world. Because you are more than a conqueror through Christ Jesus. Because the enemy is under your feet. Jesus said in Luke 10:19, "Behold, I GIVE UNTO YOU POWER to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy, and nothing shall by any means hurt you." Power to tread. Authority to crush. Dominion to overcome. This is your inheritance as a believer. This is your position in Christ. This is your legal standing in the realm of the spirit. Now, open your mouth and begin to exercise dominion. I decree by the authority given to me in Christ Jesus that I have dominion over every lion that has roared against my destiny. Every lion of poverty, I tread on you now. Every lion of sickness, I crush you now. Every lion of failure, I trample you now. EVERY ADDER THAT HAS BEEN HIDING in my path waiting to strike, I EXPOSE YOU BY THE LIGHT OF GOD'S GLORY AND I DESTROY YOU BY THE FIRE of the Holy Ghost. Every young lion rising against my future, I abort your assignment now. Every dragon of ancestral curse, every dragon of generational bondage, EVERY DRAGON OF family affliction, I COMMAND YOU TO BE BOUND AND CAST INTO THE ABYSS NOW. In the mighty name of Jesus. I am not a victim. I am a victor. I am not prey. I am a predator in the spirit. I am not running. I am reigning. I have been given authority over all the power of the enemy and nothing shall by any means hurt me. Now, we come to the climax of this psalm. Verse 14, 15, and 16 are the words of God himself. Up until now, the psalmist has been speaking, but now God interrupts and begins to speak directly. Listen to what he says. Because he had set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him. I will set him on high because he have known my seven promises from the mouth of God. I will deliver him. I will set him on high. I will answer him. I will be with him. I will deliver him again. I will honor him. I will satisfy him with long life. These are not suggestions. These are not possibilities. These are covenant declarations from the throne of the almighty. And they are activated by two conditions. Because he has set his love upon me, because he has known my name. Set his love. This is not casual affection. This is covenant commitment. This is wholehearted devotion. This is the love that says, "God, you are my first priority. You are my ultimate treasure. You are my greatest delight." When you love God like that, when you set your love upon him in an irrevocable way, he responds with deliverance. He responds with elevation. He responds with protection. He responds with honor. And known my name. This is not intellectual knowledge. This is experiential intimacy. This is revelation knowledge. This is the knowing that comes from encounter. When you know God's name, you know his nature. You know his character. You know his covenant. You know his promises. And when you know his name, you can call upon it with confidence. You can decree it with authority. You can invoke it with power. Let me prophesy again. The spirit of the Lord is speaking to someone who has been praying and it seems like heaven is silent. Someone who has been crying out and it feels like God is not listening. Someone who has been standing on the word but nothing is changing. The Lord says, "I have heard every prayer. I have seen every tear. I have recorded every cry. And because you have set your love upon me, because you have not turned away, because you have not given up, I am about to deliver you in a way that will shock you. I am about to set you on high in a way that will confuse your enemies. I am about to honor you in a way that will silence your critics. What you are about to experience is not gradual improvement. It is sudden transformation. IT IS INSTANT REVERSAL. IT IS miraculous intervention. HOLD ON. DO NOT let go. Do not give up. Deliverance Shout a prophetic amen. He shall call upon me and I will answer him. This is the prayer promise. This is the guarantee of divine response. You do not have to wonder if God hears you. You do not have to question if your prayers are reaching heaven. He said, "You will call and I will answer." Not maybe. Not sometimes. I will answer. The Bible says in Jeremiah 33:3, "Call on to me and I will answer thee and show thee great and mighty things which thou knowest not. Call and I will answer. Pray and I will respond. Seek and you will find. Knock and the door will be open." I will be with him in trouble. God is not promising to keep you from trouble. He is promising to be with you in trouble. There is a difference. Some people think that faith means YOU WILL NEVER FACE CHALLENGES. That is not what the Bible teaches. The Bible teaches that faith means you will overcome challenges. Faith means you will go through the fire and not be burned. Faith means you will walk through the valley and fear no evil. Faith means that even in trouble, even in the storm, even in the battle, God is with you. And when God is with you, trouble becomes a testimony. When God is with you, the valley becomes a place of vision. When God is with you, the storm becomes a stage for miracles. The three Hebrew boys went into the fire, but they came out without the smell of smoke because God was with them in the fire. Daniel went into the lion's den, but he came out without a scratch because God was with him in the den. Joseph went into the prison, but he came out as a prime minister because God was with him in the prison. So, do not be afraid of trouble. Do not run from challenges. Do not panic when the storm comes because God is with you. And if God is with you, who can be against you? Lift up your voice and pray. Father, I thank you that you are with me in every trouble I face. I thank you that I am not alone in the battle. I thank you that I do not fight in my own strength. I decree that every trouble that has come against me, you are turning it into testimony. Every valley I have walked through, I will deliver him and honor him. Deliverance and honor. Freedom and promotion. Liberation and elevation. God does not just deliver you and leave you where you are. He delivers you and lifts you up. He breaks the chains and opens the doors. He removes the obstacles and releases the opportunities. Deliverance is the removal of limitation. Honor is the addition OF DISTINCTION. WHEN GOD delivers you, he is saying, "I am removing what has been holding you back." When God honors you, HE IS SAYING, "I AM releasing what has been waiting for you." And I need to tell you that honor from God is better than honor from men. Honor from men can be withdrawn. Honor from God is permanent. Honor from men depends on their opinion. Honor from God depends on his covenant. Honor from men can be corrupted by jealousy. Honor from God cannot be touched by envy. When God honors you, no man can dishonor you. When God promotes you, no man can demote you. When God opens a door for you, no man can shut it. The Bible says in Proverbs 22:4, "By humility and the fear of the Lord are riches and honor and life." Honor comes from God. Promotion comes from God. Elevation comes from God. And when it comes from him, it is sustained by him. It is protected by him. It is permanent. I decree honor over your life right now. I decree that the season of shame is over. I decree that the season of obscurity is finished. I decree that God is about to honor you in the presence of those who dishonored you. He is about to promote you in the sight of those who demoted you. He is about to elevate you before the eyes of those who rejected you. Get ready for honor. Get ready for distinction. Get ready for recognition. Not from men, but from God. And when God does it, it is irreversible. "With long life will I satisfy him and show him my salvation." Long life. Not just long years, but satisfied years. Quality and quantity. Days that are full of joy. Years that are full of purpose. A life that is rich in meaning. A life that is abundant in blessing. A life that is crowned with favor, a life that is marked by divine presence. And then he says, "I will show" This is the ultimate promise. That in your lifetime you will see the salvation of the Lord. You will witness his intervention. You will experience his miracles. You will testify of his goodness. You will declare his faithfulness. You will see with your own eyes that God is real. That he is good. That he is faithful. That he keeps his word. Now, I want to pray for specific areas of your life. I want to target the specific battles you are facing. I want to address the specific challenges you are dealing with. And I want you to pray with me. Do not be passive. Do not be a spectator. Open your mouth and agree with me in the spirit. For those battling with sickness, with infirmity, with disease, with pain, I decree divine health over your body now. By the stripes of Jesus, you are healed. By the blood of Jesus, every affliction is canceled. I command every spirit of infirmity to leave your body now. Every sickness that has been planted in your bloodstream, I command it to die now. Every disease that has been assigned to cut your life short, I abort it now. Every pain that has tormented you, I silence it now. I decree that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost. I decree that divine life is flowing through your veins. I decree that you will live and not die. You will fulfill your days. You will walk in divine health. You will be satisfied with long life. For those struggling with finances, with debt, with poverty, with lack, I decree financial breakthrough over your life now. The windows of heaven are open over you. THE STOREHOUSES OF GOD ARE releasing provision for you. I BREAK EVERY CURSE OF POVERTY. I DESTROY every spirit of lack. I cancel every assignment OF FINANCIAL LIMITATION. I DECREE that money will come TO YOU FROM UNEXPECTED SOURCES. I DECREE THAT DOORS of opportunity will open for you suddenly. I DECREE THAT IDEAS will come to you that will generate wealth. I decree that you will lend and not borrow. You will BE THE HEAD AND NOT THE TAIL. YOU WILL BE ABOVE AND NOT BENEATH. THE WEALTH OF THE WICKED is stored UP FOR YOU. GET READY FOR FINANCIAL TURNAROUND. GET READY FOR SUPERNATURAL PROVISION. GET ready for abundance.
